"Why did you not raise children born in the fifth month, my lord?"
What is the reason?"
Yīng said,
"Children born in the fifth month

Wén said,
"Does a person receive his fate from Heaven?
Or does he receive his fate from the door?"
Yīng was silent.
Wén said,
"If we must receive our fate from Heaven,
then what is there for you to worry about, my lord?
If we must receive our fate from the door,
then we can just make the door taller,
who can reach it then!"
Yīng said,
"Rest, my son."
After a long while,
Wén Chéng leisurely asked his father, Yīng, saying,

He said,
"A grandson."
"What is the son of a grandson?"
He said,
"A great-grandson."
"What is the son of a great-grandson?"
He said,
"I cannot know."
Wén said,
"You have been in charge of affairs as prime minister of Qí,

I have heard that the household of a general is sure to produce generals,

I am secretly surprised by this."

After a year,

At that time, Mèngcháng Jūn was the prime minister of Qí,

Mèngcháng Jūn 孟嘗君 was worried about this.

Mèngcháng Jūn 孟嘗君 then presented Féng Huān 馮驩 and requested of him, saying,

Xuē 薛 has not had a good year,

Féng Huān 冯驩 said,

Arriving at Xuē 薛,

Then he brewed much wine,
bought fat cattle,

They all held their vouchers for borrowing money and gathered together.
They prepared a meeting.
Every day they slaughtered oxen and set out wine.
When the wine was flowing freely,

Those who were able to pay the interest,

Those who were poor and unable to pay the interest,

He said:
"The reason that Mèngcháng Jūn lent money,

The reason that interest was collected,

Now, those who are rich and supplied will be given a payment date.
For the poor, the vouchers are burned to be renounced.
Everyone, please eat and drink heartily.
With a lord like this,
how can we betray him!"
All those seated rose,

Mèngcháng Jūn heard that Féng Huān had burned the vouchers,

Huān arrived,
and Mèngcháng Jūn said:
"Wén has three thousand retainers,

Why?"
Féng Huān said:
"Indeed.
Without preparing plentiful beef and wine, I could not gather everyone together,

I set a date for repayment.
For those lacking,

If they are desperate,

Above, it would give the impression that you, my lord, are greedy for profit and do not care for your scholars and people.
Below, there would be a reputation for alienating superiors and repudiating debts.
This is not the way to encourage scholars and people and make your name known.
Burning useless debt bonds,
discarding unattainable calculations,
will make the people of Xuē feel close to you and publicize your good reputation.
Why do you doubt it, my lord?"
Mèngcháng Jūn then clapped his hands in thanks.

Féng Huān] said:

The world transmits that Mèngcháng Jūn was fond of entertaining guests and pleased with himself;

《Biography of Píngyuán Jūn and Yú Qīng, Number Sixteen》
Píngyuán Jūn, Zhào Shèng,
was a son of the Zhào state.
Among the sons, Shèng was the most virtuous,
fond of guests;
the guests who arrived numbered in the thousands.
Píngyuán Jūn served as chancellor to King Huìwén of Zhào and King Xiàochéng,
resigning three times,
and being reinstated three times,
with a fief in Dōngwǔ City.
The tower of Píngyuán Jūn's house overlooked a commoner's house.
In the commoner's house was a cripple,
who crawled around to draw water.
A beautiful woman of Píngyuán Jūn lived in the tower above,
looked down and saw him,
and laughed loudly at him.
The next day,
the cripple arrived at Píngyuán Jūn's gate,
and requested, saying:
"I have heard that Your Lordship enjoys associating with gentlemen;
gentlemen do not consider it far to come thousands of miles to you,
because Your Lordship is able to esteem gentlemen and despise concubines.
I unfortunately suffer from an infirmity,
And the ladies of your (my Lord's) harem ridiculed me.
I desire the heads of those who laughed at me!"
Píngyuán Jūn 平原君 laughed and replied,
"Agreed."
The cripple departed.
Píngyuán Jūn 平原君 laughed and said,
"Look at this lad,
he actually wants to kill my beautiful women because of a laugh,
isn't that excessive!"
In the end, he did not kill her.
After more than a year,
the guests and retainers leaving his household gradually numbered more than half.
Píngyuán Jūn 平原君 was puzzled by this
and said,
"I, Shèng 勝, have never dared to be disrespectful in how I treat you all,
yet why are so many leaving?"
One of the retainers stepped forward and replied,
"Because you did not kill the woman who laughed at the cripple,
they consider you to love beauty and despise men of worth,
and so the men leave."
Thereupon, Píngyuán Jūn 平原君 beheaded the beautiful woman who laughed at the cripple,
went personally to the cripple's door,
and apologized.
After that, his retainers gradually returned.
At that time, Qí 齊 had Mèngcháng 孟嘗,
Wèi 魏 had Xìnlíng 信陵,
Chǔ 楚 had Chūnshēn 春申,
so they competed to win over men of talent to serve them.
When Qín besieged Hándān,
Zhào sent Píngyuán Jūn to seek help,
to form an alliance with Chǔ.
He agreed to take twenty men from his retainers and followers who possessed courage, strength, literary, and military talents.
Píngyuán Jūn said:
"If we can achieve victory through literary persuasion,
that would be excellent.
If we cannot achieve victory through literary persuasion,
then we will take an oath of blood under the magnificent house,
and we will surely secure the alliance and return.
We will not seek men from outside;
taking them from my retainers and followers will be sufficient."
He found nineteen men,
and there were no others he could take,
so he could not fulfill the number of twenty.
Among his followers was Máo Suì,
who stepped forward and recommended himself to Píngyuán Jūn, saying:
"Suì has heard that you, my lord, are going to form an alliance with Chǔ,
agreeing to take twenty men from your retainers and followers,
without seeking men from outside.
Now there is one man lacking,
I wish that you, my lord, would consider Suì as one to fulfill the quota and go."
Píngyuán Jūn said:
"Sir, how many years have you been in Shèng's household?"
Máo Suì said:
"Three years here."
Píngyuán Jūn said:
"Now, the way a virtuous scholar conducts himself in the world is,
like an awl in a bag,
its tip will immediately be visible.
Now, you, sir, have been under the patronage of Shèng (平原君的門客名) for three years here,
yet those around him have not praised you,
and Shèng (平原君) has not heard of you;
this means you have nothing to offer.
You, sir, are incapable;
you, sir, should stay."
Máo Suì (毛遂) said:
"I have only today requested to be placed in the bag.
If I had obtained a place in the bag earlier,
I would have already broken out with my full point,
and it would not have been just the tip that was visible."
Píngyuán Jūn (平原君) finally went together with Máo Suì (毛遂).
The nineteen men looked at each other and laughed, but did not dismiss him.
When Máo Suì (毛遂) arrived in Chǔ (楚),
he debated with the nineteen men,
and the nineteen men were all convinced.
Píngyuán Jūn (平原君) discussed an alliance with Chǔ (楚),
explaining the benefits and drawbacks.
He spoke of it from sunrise,
but by midday, a decision had not been reached.
The nineteen men said to Máo Suì (毛遂):
"Sir, please go up."
Máo Suì (毛遂), with his hand on his sword, ascended the steps and said to Píngyuán Jūn (平原君):
"The advantages and disadvantages of following him [Zhao],
can be decided with just a few words.
Today you came out and said you would follow,

The King of Chǔ asked Píngyuán Jūn,
"What is this guest?"
Píngyuán Jūn said,
"He is a retainer of Shèng."
The King of Chǔ scolded,
"Why don't you come down!
I am speaking with your lord,

Máo Suì pressed his sword and stepped forward, saying,
"The reason Your Majesty scolds Suì

But now, within ten paces,
Your Majesty cannot rely on the strength of Chǔ,
Your Majesty's life is in Suì's hands.
My lord is before you,

"Furthermore, I have heard that Tāng became king of the world with seventy *lǐ* of land,
and King Wén made the feudal lords his subjects with a hundred *lǐ* of territory.
Was it because their soldiers were numerous?
It was truly because they could rely on their strength and exert their power.
Now Chǔ has a territory of five thousand *lǐ*,

These are the resources of a hegemon.
With the strength of Chǔ,
none in the world could match it.
Bái Qǐ,
merely a young lad,

raised an army to battle with Chǔ.
In one battle he captured Yān and Yǐng,
in a second battle he burned Yílíng,

This is a hundred generations of hatred and what Zhào is ashamed of,

The alliance is for Chǔ,
not for Zhào.
My lord is before you,

The King of Chǔ said:
"Yes, yes,
indeed, what you say is true,
I respectfully offer the state to follow [the alliance]."
Máo Suì said:

The King of Chǔ said:

Máo Suì said to the attendants of the King of Chǔ:

Máo Suì held a bronze tray, knelt, and presented it to the King of Chǔ, saying:
"Your Majesty should smear the blood to confirm the alliance,
next is my lord,
"The next matter is settled."
Thereupon, the alliance was settled upon in the palace.
Máo Suì, with his left hand holding the tray of blood and his right hand beckoning to the nineteen men, said:
"Gentlemen, please all smear your mouths with this blood here below the hall.
You are all unremarkable,

Píngyuán Jūn, having settled the alliance, returned,

"Shèng dares not again assess men.
Shèng has assessed as many as a thousand men,

Mister Máo, with three inches of tongue,

Píngyuán Jūn, having returned to Zhào,

Qín urgently besieged Hándān,
Hándān was in dire straits,
Moreover, they surrendered.
Píngyuán Jūn 平原君 was deeply worried about this.
Lǐ Tóng 李同, the son of a post station official in Hándān 邯鄲, said to Píngyuán Jūn 平原君:

Píngyuán Jūn 平原君 said:

That you accepted the prime minister's seal without declining due to lack of ability,

He also thought it was because they were relatives.

Lord Píngyuán (平原君) died in the fifteenth year of King Xiàochéng of Zhào (趙孝成王).

When Zōu Yǎn (鄒衍) passed through Zhào (趙) and spoke of the supreme Dao,

Yú Qīng (虞卿) was a wandering persuader.

After a second audience,
He served as a senior minister (Shàngqīng) in the state of Zhào,

Chǔ and Wèi, desiring to obtain Your Majesty's rich treasures,
Wei desires to obtain the king's treasures,

If Zhao sends men to Chu
and Wei, Qin will surely suspect the alliance of the world,

If it's like this,

The King of Zhao did not listen,

Qin received him.
The King of Zhao summoned Yu Qing and said:

Yu Qing replied:
"Your Majesty will not obtain a truce,

Those in the world who celebrate victory are all in Qin.
Zheng Zhu,
is a noble,
entering Qin,
the King of Qin and Lord Ying will certainly conspicuously honor him to show the world.
Chu and Wei, thinking that Zhao has made a truce,

If Qin knows that the world will not save Your Majesty,

Lord Ying indeed conspicuously honored Zheng Zhu to show the world's celebrators of victory,
He ultimately refused to make peace.
After the great defeat at Chángpíng 長平,
Qín 秦 then besieged Hándān 邯鄲,
becoming a laughingstock to the world.
After Qín 秦 lifted the siege of Hándān 邯鄲,
the King of Zhào 趙 entered the court (of Qín 秦),

Yú Qīng 虞卿 said to the King of Zhào 趙:

Or did they love Your Majesty and not attack, even though their strength still allowed them to advance?"
The King said:
"When Qín 秦 attacked me,
they spared no effort,

Yú Qīng 虞卿 said:
"Qín 秦 attacked to the point where they could not take the place,

At that time,

He spent his days and nights drinking with his guests,
drinking fine wine,

He indulged in pleasure day and night for four years

in order to attract worthy men.

is the remaining legacy of a hegemonic state.
